authority: routing reports requested action only; every state-changing effect is denied unless a separate trusted external owner manifest matches action, project, contour, exact scope, resources, turn and expiry
activation_gate: separate review, explicit installation, and observed shadow evaluation; not part of PR merge

events.UserPromptSubmit: classify mode and return routing manifest
events.SessionStart: load project identity, current SHA, governance, and active-work pointers
events.PreCompact: adapter proposal: append one verified private checkpoint delta only with external write-memory authority
events.PostCompact: return a short resume manifest, never a transcript
events.PreToolUse: check project, contour, authority, and absolute denials
events.PostToolUse: record evidence pointer and hash instead of large output
events.Stop: adapter proposal: append verified delta only with external write-memory authority; never rewrite SESSION.md
